class Solution:
    def threeSum(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        nums.sort()
        res = []
        n = len(nums)
        for i in range(n - 2):
            if nums[i] > 0:                       # early exit
                break
            if i > 0 and nums[i] == nums[i - 1]:  # skip duplicate anchors
                continue
            l, r = i + 1, n - 1
            while l < r:
                s = nums[i] + nums[l] + nums[r]
                if s == 0:
                    res.append([nums[i], nums[l], nums[r]])
                    l += 1
                    r -= 1
                    while l < r and nums[l] == nums[l - 1]:  # skip dup left
                        l += 1
                    while l < r and nums[r] == nums[r + 1]:  # skip dup right
                        r -= 1
                elif s < 0:
                    l += 1
                else:
                    r -= 1
        return res

class Solution:
    def addTwoNumbers(self, l1: list[int], l2: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        # Input/output as lists (representing linked list values in reverse order)
        # Write your solution here
        
        carry = 0
        res = []
        i = 0
        while i<len(l1) or i<len(l2) or carry:
            val = carry
            if i<len(l1):
                val += l1[i]
            if i<len(l2):
                val += l2[i]
            carry = val // 10
            temp = val % 10
            res.append(temp)
            i += 1
        return res
